K-means clusters

The four groups

Each group is described the same way so they can be compared line by line. Every figure is a group average from the Worldpay report (payment mix), the World Bank Global Findex (accounts, debit card ownership, digital payments) or the IMF Financial Access Survey (cards and ATMs per adult, averaged over the markets that report them). Points this data cannot test, such as strategy, regulation, trust and infrastructure, are left out.

All 42 markets

Access and infrastructure features

World Bank Findex figures are for 2024 and IMF figures for 2025 unless a year is shown beside them. A dash means the market reports no figure.

Source: Worldpay, The Global Payments Report 2026 (11th edition). Payment method shares are % of 2025 transaction value and card scheme shares are for 2024 (the latest the report gives); both were read from the report by script, and totals may not equal 100% because of rounding. Dollar values for payment methods are our own arithmetic: the 2025 share times the report's 2025 market size. Card schemes get no dollar value because their shares are for 2024. Account, debit card and digital payment figures are from the World Bank Global Findex Database (2024 survey round where available, otherwise 2021). ATM, branch, card and mobile and internet banking figures are from the IMF Financial Access Survey: 2025 where published, otherwise the latest earlier year, shown beside each figure in the hover card; some markets report none. The clusters are our own k-means grouping of the 2025 payment mix and the two Findex access measures, not something any of the sources publishes; the IMF and forecast figures are reference data only. Brands and logos are the "popular payment methods" the report shows for each market, and are trademarks of their owners. The one-line description under each brand is ours, not the report's.
